project: Wuxia Life P27 Habit Pool Expansion And Consequence Wiring
description: Second-round habit pool migration: P20 replay mirrors, P21 echo wiring, P17 mentor/renown consequences, and one medical habit sample.

userStories.title: P27 pool expansion scope and audit delta
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an updated audit delta from P26 closure so P27 migrations target the highest-value remaining pools.
acceptanceCriteria: Re-inventory legacy *_habit readers in replay surfaces, echo hooks, and validation fixtures
Classify each hit and map to P27 story execution order
Save the audit under docs/test-reports or docs/designs
Do not modify gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Wire P21 study echo callback to studyHabit
